items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, before Elvin joined that band we had Billy Higgins.

ctx.x: So what was it like? Do you remember that first time you played in that group? Do you remember sitting down at the piano, there’s John, there’s Elvin, there’s Jimmy.
Well, before Elvin joined that band we had Billy Higgins.
Didn’t he have a beautiful smile?
